title: CAR-003 Frozen Analysis Plan
description: Logical mirror of the G56R-003 spec-scoped analysis-plan contract. The Pareto dimension set is identical to the twin's frozen policy per FR-018. The campaign budget carries the Claude-platform cache ceilings FR-022 enumerates. The multiplicity declaration is expanded to the three families FR-050 requires.

calibration_binding.description: FR-037: references the versioned calibration protocol that calibration-partition pairs bind. This is the receiving end of the circular-dependency resolution; the plan freezes after calibration, so calibration pairs bind the protocol instead of the plan.

minimum_unique_tasks.description: FR-054: the manifest-wide floor. Each stratum additionally declares its own stratum_minimum_unique_tasks, because a guardrail is evaluated per stratum and a manifest-wide floor says nothing about whether any single stratum can support the percentile it claims.

guardrail_method.description: FR-053: the four p95_*_max fields below are thresholds only. This object supplies the rest of the comparison, without which a bare ceiling is not a decidable test. Declared once for the manifest so every stratum is evaluated identically.

denominator.description: FR-053: the population the percentile is computed over. Without it the same threshold means different things per attempt, per pair, and per task.

comparator.description: FR-053: absolute_ceiling compares the observed percentile against the frozen p95_*_max. relative_to_comparator_arm compares the candidate arm against its paired comparator arm, with margin applied.

margin.description: FR-053: distinct from the FR-018 non-inferiority margins and never reused from them. Zero means the threshold is applied exactly.

confidence_method.description: FR-054: point_estimate compares the sample percentile directly and is only defensible at large n. upper_confidence_bound compares a distribution-free bound built from the order statistics, which is what keeps the comparison honest when a stratum is small.

missing_data_rule.description: FR-053: MUST NOT be silent exclusion. Failed, timed-out, and cancelled attempts are the ones most likely to occupy the upper tail, so dropping them biases the percentile downward and contradicts FR-020's prohibition on complete-case filtering. worst_case_imputation assigns the stratum ceiling to an attempt with no observation; report_jointly evaluates the guardrail only alongside the attrition count so the omission stays visible.

direction.description: FR-053: which way is worse. All four guarded quantities are costs, so higher is worse; stating it makes a breach objectively decidable rather than inferred from the _max suffix.

multiplicity_family.description: FR-053: guardrails form a family of their own, distinct from the three FR-050 families, which cover the conjunctive floors-and-non-inferiority stage, the Pareto disjunctive half, and the across-ladder family. A guardrail belongs to none of them, so leaving it unassigned would leave a set of thresholds evaluated with no stated error control.

breach_result.description: FR-053 and FR-019: a breach returns no qualification. It is never traded off against another dimension and never resolved by weighting.

decision_bearing.description: FR-053: guardrails gate qualification but are NOT Pareto dimensions. The decision vector stays at the eight of FR-018; each added dimension would weaken dominance as a discriminator and raise the inconclusive rate.

membership_rule.description: FR-052: the rule assigning a task to this stratum, stated in the frozen plan rather than left to the implementation. permitted_basis reuses the closed pre-execution set the assignment record's stratum_assignment carries, every member of which the role-corpus contract already binds before execution.

derived_from_realized_outcomes.description: FR-052: pinned false. Realized duration, turns, tokens, retries, and compactions are post-treatment quantities; stratifying on them conditions the comparison on a consequence of the treatment, and would let the powered long-horizon stratum be populated after results are visible.

stratum_minimum_unique_tasks.description: FR-054: the per-stratum estimability floor. A 95th percentile from a small sample is unstable — a distribution-free interval for an extreme upper percentile can fall well below its nominal confidence level at small n — so a stratum below this floor returns inconclusive rather than passing by default or being silently skipped.

stratum_sample_size.description: FR-052: every stratum, and the powered long_horizon stratum in particular, carries its own sample size rather than inheriting the pooled one. A stratum reported as a finding without an independent power declaration is a post-hoc subgroup rather than a prespecified one.

reliability_guardrails.description: FR-053: retry, compaction, and late-failure guardrails, frozen alongside the resource and duration ones. retries and compactions are already Pareto dimensions under FR-018, but pairwise dominance imposes no ABSOLUTE bound — two arms can both be unacceptably retry-heavy and still be mutually non-dominated — so these ceilings are a separate obligation from the decision vector and, like the p95 guardrails, are not decision-bearing dimensions.

late_failure_definition.description: FR-053: 'late failure' is defined rather than assumed. A late failure is a candidate-plane terminal failure reached after the attempt has consumed at least this fraction of its per-attempt budget — the expensive failure mode, because the resource is spent and no outcome is produced. The failure itself is already classified by the closed candidate-plane codes; this only fixes what makes it late.

quality_floors.description: FR-017: absolute semantic and reliability floors, applied before non-inferiority.

multiplicity_declaration.description: FR-050: three distinct families, not one global correction. Cluster-adjusted variance is a precondition, not a multiplicity control.

pareto_policy.description: FR-018 and FR-049: exactly eight decision-bearing dimensions, identical to the Codex twin. reasoning_output_tokens is reported but excluded; adding it must be a joint cross-platform change.

campaign_budget.description: FR-038: this budget is authoritative. The experiment-policy budget must equal it for qualification-eligible partitions.

racing_policy.description: FR-055: racing stops a comparison early on accumulating evidence, so its content must be frozen, not merely its existence. Repeatedly testing accumulating data inflates the false-positive rate when boundaries are left unadjusted, which is a FOURTH error-control concern distinct from the three FR-050 multiplicity families — those address dimensions and ladders, not repeated looks over time.

interim_looks.description: The number and information timing of every planned look. Information fractions are prespecified so a look cannot be added, moved, or repeated once an outcome is visible.

boundary.description: How the inflation from repeated looks is controlled. An alpha-spending boundary distributes the total error rate across the planned looks rather than testing at the nominal level each time.

look_schedule_frozen.description: FR-055: pinned true. A look added after any outcome is visible invalidates the declaration rather than being absorbed into it.

early_stop_biases_estimate.description: FR-055: pinned true. Stopping early biases the effect estimate, so a raced comparison is reported as stopped with its stopping reason and never presented as a completed one.

stop_scope.description: FR-021 already requires complete-pair, arm-symmetric handling, so a stop retires the pair as a whole and never a single arm.

futility_policy.description: FR-055: futility stops a comparison that is unlikely to reach a conclusion. Its boundary type must be declared because a binding boundary is part of the error-rate calculation while a non-binding one may be overridden without invalidating it — the two are not interchangeable.

boundary_binding.description: FR-055: binding means crossing the boundary MUST stop the comparison and the boundary is credited in the error-rate calculation. non_binding means it MAY be overridden, so no error-rate credit is taken.

pre_cohort_outcome_absence_digest.description: SC-012: evidence that the plan froze before any CAR-007 through CAR-010 outcome-bearing cohort evidence was observed.

max_cache_write_tokens_by_ttl_class.description: FR-022: closed TTL-class key space, identical to the experiment-policy budget and the additive cache diagnostic. Required for the FR-038 budget-equality check to be decidable.
